questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully in the frame (e.g., frames 7-13), exactly three pens are visible arranged in a row.
All three pens are oriented with the black cap at the bottom and the translucent barrel pointing up. This orientation is consistent across all frames where pens are visible.
All three pens have identical translucent grey barrels and black caps. There is no color variation between them.
All pens appear to have their caps on (black ends visible). They appear to be of equal length.
The board moves steadily from left to right across the frames. The position of the board relative to the rail changes consistently in each frame, indicating smooth motion without pauses or reversals.
The pens maintain their relative spacing and position on the board throughout the sequence. They do not slide or shift independently.

parsed.reason: The video shows a white board moving smoothly from left to right carrying three identical pens. The pens are correctly oriented, capped, and spaced. There are no missing items, orientation errors, or motion failures.
